scenarios: shell: reject pre prevents side effect, next independent call and same-session user turn complete
shell: reject post masks full result, next independent call and same-session user turn complete

packaged_live_smoke.installation: Fresh extracted ZIP without plugin node_modules
packaged_live_smoke.continuation: Every rejection case verifies another independently approved tool and a new user turn in the same session, with the same running server/plugin and approval control identity.

review.status: completed; no unresolved findings in per-action rejection, post redaction and cancellation races
verified: Pre refusal uses recoverable typed Tool.Error through the pinned Effect API
Rejection affects only the current bound checkpoint; parallel and parent/child checkpoints remain independent
Post refusal replaces the complete result/error including structured output and metadata
Native cancellation invalidates in-flight checks without preventing subsequent turns
Approval cancellation during server startup cannot leave an orphan request

limits: Classifier remains an always-deny stub; unavailability intentionally fails open.
No rollback after post, OS sandbox, or provider-hosted tool enforcement.
Live MCP uses direct tools with codemode=false; unit tests cover CodeMode IDs and parallel/child calls.
Pre refusals may have no post hook because the tool did not execute.
Already-running parallel tools may finish; each intercepted checkpoint requires its own decision.
An independently installed legacy V1 adapter can still latch sessions; remove it from discovery when upgrading.
Self-load failures before hook registration cannot be enforced by the plugin.
